resources.title: Alertmanager Routing Config (alertmanager.yml)
resources.description: A real Alertmanager config for Northbridge's checkout service: grouping by alertname/team, a routing tree that sends critical checkout alerts to PagerDuty and error-budget warnings to a dedicated Slack channel, an inhibit rule suppressing latency alerts when the service is already fully down, and a documented amtool command for creating a planned-maintenance silence.

resources.title: Prometheus Alerting & Recording Rules (checkout-alerts.yml)
resources.description: The Prometheus-side rule file Alertmanager above receives from: CheckoutHighErrorRate and CheckoutServiceDown from Lesson 19, CheckoutHighLatency using Lesson 16's histogram_quantile() pattern, and a checkout-error-budget group with a recording rule plus both a 30-day exhaustion alert and a fast-burn alert built from Chapter 1 Lesson 3's 99.9% SLO math.

resources.title: Grafana Checkout-Health Dashboard (JSON export)
resources.description: A valid, importable Grafana dashboard JSON exactly matching Lesson 18's checkout-health dashboard: request rate by status, p95 latency, error rate, active pod count, plus a fifth panel showing the live 30-day error-budget-remaining percentage computed from the recording rule in prometheus-alerting-rules.yml. Import via Grafana's Dashboards > Import JSON.

resources.title: SLO / Error-Budget Tracking Spreadsheet
resources.description: A CSV starter tracking weekly error-budget burn for checkout (99.9% SLO) and product-catalog (99.5% SLO), pre-filled with 10 weeks of realistic sample data including a real Breached week matching Lesson 3's flash-sale worked example, so you can see what budget burn and recovery actually look like before logging your own services.
